summary: @servicetitan/standalone-ui 2.2.5 executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime at preinstall
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, marks it executable, and uses it to run a bundled ~727KB obfuscated file `math_init.js` (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, containing a rotated string-array `MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())` VM and a large numeric lookup table). The setup script itself uses obfuscated identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`). Executing the payload under an alien runtime fetched at install time evades Node-focused install-time inspection and bypasses tooling that only traces npm-resolved JavaScript. The behavior is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a React/MobX shared UI component library for `@servicetitan/standalone-ui`), and package.json ships with empty `author` metadata and an `ISC` license. The combination of a runtime-dropper preinstall, an obfuscated executable blob invoked via that runtime, and mismatched declared purpose is the install-time RCE shape and is consistent with a scope compromise or in-scope typosquat rather than a legitimate ServiceTitan release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
